method.input: npm run playtest:visible TTY JSON mode; visible UI, handbook, and facility map only

outcomes.notes: Disabled coil I. Surviving enemies pressured the boss approach. Died after moving close and reloading.

Coil III visibly OFF; coil II was at 69% before final firing action. The final action announced BROADCAST COIL DISABLED immediately before death, supporting a second disabled coil; final end screen does not enumerate coils.

ratingReasons.gameplay: Useful optic precision, regenerating shield, clear close-range Shift interruption, alternate routes and a shuttered three-coil boss create a workable combat loop. Receiver pickups sustain momentum. Repeated small emitter targets and overlapping rear pressure made the boss less satisfying than ordinary enemy combat in these two attempts.
ratingReasons.presentation: Strong, consistent rain-soaked industrial mood; cyan/amber lighting, reflective ground, large signs, weapon silhouette and polished title/pause/end UI. Simple box-like enemies, repeated props and sparse character animation remain visibly modest.
ratingReasons.usability: Readable handbook controls, pausing map, explicit objectives, restart and supply restoration all worked. Floor-ring recovery sometimes required another step, and direct objective markers could point into walls or cover until I consulted the map.
ratingReasons.readability: Large location signs and numbered coil plates help. Small optic targets, small offscreen directional cues, dense HUD content and cover occlusion required several aim and route corrections. I could see target damage when shots reached a live coil.
ratingReasons.aaaReadiness: This feels like a coherent polished prototype/vertical slice, with visible limits in geometry, animation, enemy variety, encounter scope and combat clarity. I did not see enough breadth or production detail to rate it near AAA readiness.
ratingReasons.replayability: Route choices and improved enemy clearing gave a reason to retry; attempt two improved eliminations and boss progress. Only the single mission and rifle were experienced.

observations.detail: Visible PHASE BREAK / SHOT CANCELED, followed by a sentinel elimination.

observations.finding: Map made the medical bay route understandable
observations.detail: A direct movement toward the Heart hit the medical bay wall. Map showed the wall and I exited through the south/east side.

observations.finding: Foreground cover frequently hid live coil bodies
observations.detail: My shots did not damage coils while they were screened. Repositioning to the other side exposed coil III and disabled it.

observations.finding: Coil damage and disabled state were legible when correctly aimed
observations.detail: Coil III became dark and HUD said 3 OFF; coil II later showed 90% then 69%.

reviewerPlayErrors: Several bursts missed moving optics or struck cover.
I collided with low cover and a medical bay wall during navigation.
First attempt to recover west memory in attempt two was outside the ring; a small reposition succeeded.
I advanced into boss combat while distant enemies remained alive.
Shift was used too far from the Custodian to interrupt it.

limitations: Exactly two deaths; no win or extraction upload experienced.
Screenshot-driven discrete inputs with automatic pauses do not reproduce continuous human mouse play.
Software-WebGL fallback was reported; this is not a GPU/performance benchmark.
Audio and continuous frame pacing were not assessed.
Immediate HUD values sometimes preceded screenshot rendering; camera judgments were based on screenshots.
No source, prior reviews, routes, solutions, tests, git history or internal game state consulted.
